svg.text: REFERENCE ONLY — DO NOT UPLOAD THIS FILE. Upload bracket_flat.dxf.
Fridge-side display mount — flat pattern, A36/1008 mild steel 0.187" (4.75 mm)
portrait · formed arm 180 + neck 257 + body 310 mm · arm width 190 mm · bend deduction 8.19 mm · flat 310.0 x 738.8 mm
dashed LINE in the DXF — the app reads
ARM — rests on the fridge top
O48.0 x 11.51 mm body / O48.0 x 11.51 mm arm
4 x 18 strap slots, 5 pairs up the
neck and arm — captures the power lead
Pi fan / GPIO opening in the display's rear box,
R88 from the VESA centre — drawn in all four
rotations. A vent window covers it in each.
Display rear box 134 x 260 mm as mounted (portrait),
standing 25 mm proud of the panel.
schematic, 0.55x. Vertical load bears at the top corner; magnets carry none.
same pad, 72 mm x2 down the neck
rear box 260 x 134 x 25 mm — VESA lands here
ONE pad stock, 11.50 mm (0.453 in), everywhere the bracket meets the fridge — arm, neck and bottom. Matched to the 11.51 mm magnet so the magnets bear, not the pad.
on the NECK it is two strips 72 mm wide with a 45 mm channel between them for the straps
4 x O48 x 12 mm top-lip magnets, same SKU as the body — zero VERTICAL load, but they do resist peel
8 x O48 x 12 mm BARE nickel pot magnets, M6 female thread — tape the fridge, not the magnet
bottom bearing pad 11.50 mm, -0.01 mm proud of the magnets — sponge squashes flush
display 43 mm overall = 18 mm panel + 25 mm rear box, 3.94 kg; CG offset d = 45.7 mm, volume-weighted across both sections
A36/1008 mild steel plate 4.75 mm, inside bend R 3.17 mm
Vertical load 21.49 lbf (display 8.69 + bracket 12.80) bears at the top corner. Magnets carry ZERO vertical load.
Touch torsion: 5 lbf at 162 mm = 32.0 in-lbf over 246 mm spacing -> 3.30 lbf/side, 1.65 lbf/magnet (SF 37.1x on 61.25 lbf derated pull).

Peel 2.07 lbf over H = 278 mm — negligible, as expected. Arm pad budget 3.46 mm = corner gap at the R_f = 15 mm envelope plus crown rise; the 11.50 mm (1/4 in) pad gives 3.32x and covers a measured R_f up to 35 mm.
Display is not a slab: 18 mm panel + 25 mm raised rear box = 43 mm overall, VESA on the box. Vent windows sit at R88 so one lands over the Pi fan opening in every 90 deg rotation.
Neck bending 519 psi (SF 69x); body weak axis 430 psi (SF 84x) vs 36000 psi yield. No ribs required.
